Team — forwarding Falkon's redlines. They want to merge Exhibit B into A, add a burst pool as an addendum, and include a 90-day acceleration option. Legal flagged a few items (see below). I started a draft consolidated Change Order (RDWD_ChangeOrder_v2.docx) — attached.

Quick summary of legal comments we should address in the COA:
- Section 2.1 (Billing): Falkon removed our clause that reserves right to prorate ramped capacity; Rishi — we should push back and offer a trade (shorter notice for scale-down).
- Section 3.4 (Data residency / logs): Falkon added a clause asking for extended retention of access logs; need security sign-off if we accept.
- Section 5.2 (SLA credits): They want credits for specific burst failures — propose adding a cap and a reporting window.

Operational asks if we proceed:
- Karthik: confirm the proposed pricing when Exhibit B capacity folds into Exhibit A — target is no more than 7% uplift to committed rate.
- Marissa: can you prepare the implementation matrix draft (owner/milestone/date) and the runbook items to hand to Falkon SREs? I attached an initial spreadsheet (implementation_matrix_draft.xlsx).
- Rishi: legal to propose redline language for Section 2.1 and Section 5.2 by Friday EOD so we can send a consolidated COA.

Next steps: internal sign-off -> send consolidated COA to Falkon with a brief summary of changes and a DocuSign link. Falkon requested sign-off by 2026-07-16.

Thanks — Mina

Subject: Consolidated Change Order and implementation matrix (for signature)

Emma / Falkon legal —

Thank you for the redlines and for the alignment call last week. Attached is Redwood's consolidated Change Order (RDWD_ChangeOrder_v2.docx) which: 1) merges Exhibit B into Exhibit A; 2) adds the Burst Capacity Addendum as Exhibit B-1; 3) preserves Falkon's requested ramp schedule and includes an optional 90-day acceleration clause (see Addendum section 3); and 4) updates the billing clause to include a short prorate protection with a 30-day notice window for the burst pool.

Summary of material changes (high-level):
- Exhibit consolidation: Exhibit A now contains committed + legacy trial capacity. Exhibit B-1 is the optional burst add-on.
- Pricing: blended committed rate increases by 6.2% in the model attached; detailed fee table is in Section 2.1 of the COA.
- SLA credits: limited to three events per quarter for burst interruptions and capped at 5% of monthly invoice for that capacity tier.
- Data retention: we agreed to retain access logs for 180 days; any longer retention will require a separate SOW and security review.

Attachments: RDWD_ChangeOrder_v2.docx (consolidated COA), implementation_matrix_draft.xlsx (updated by Karthik), runbook_scope.txt

Please review. If this looks acceptable, we will route the COA via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/1234-REDWOOD-FALKON-COA. Our legal suggested small redline tweaks to Section 2.1 and Section 5.2 (see tracked changes in the DOCX); we've also included an implementation matrix with owners and target dates.

Requested next steps:
- Falkon legal: confirm Section 2.1 and 5.2 language or propose alternate wording by EOD 2026-07-15.
- Ops (Falkon SRE): confirm VPN/hostname list and sample payload by 2026-07-19 so we can hit the target cutover window.
- Once agreed, countersign via DocuSign.

If you prefer, we can split into a narrow COA for billing and then a separate SOW for extended retention — happy to discuss.

Best,
Mina Haddad
